content: Our model can be regarded as an automatic post-editing system – a system designed to fix systematic MT errors that is decoupled from the main MT system. Automatic post-editing has a long history, including rule-based BIBREF17, statistical BIBREF18 and neural approaches BIBREF19, BIBREF20, BIBREF21.
